fact: Ecofin Agency reports the Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation piloted a Unified Digital Civil Registration Service in 19 districts on 10 August 2025, with national rollout planned in phases.
Ecofin Agency says the pilot platform enables local administrations to digitally register births, marriages, divorces and deaths, stored in a central national database.

fact: The Ministry says the Unified Digital Civil Registration Service is operational in 19 districts across five Federal Member States, with plans to expand to all regions and districts.
The Ministry says the service in those 19 districts registers deaths digitally, with records stored in a central national database.
UNICEF Somalia says the digital CRVS system, piloted in 19 districts in 2023 and scaled to 48 districts in 2025, is used daily to register births, though not all regions have it.
UNICEF Somalia says the digital CRVS system is deployed with full operational capability for daily registration of vital events such as births and deaths.
The CRVS Authority says the national civil registration system is built on OpenCRVS, was approved in November 2023, and was piloted from October 2024 in 20 districts.
